technique_name: Describe the factors contributing to the current global economic crisis.
description: The current global economic crisis can be attributed to a combination of factors, including the COVID-19 pandemic, a global oversupply of oil, plummeting energy prices, plunging stock markets, a surge in unemployment, and the slowdown in global economic activity. The pandemic has caused a dramatic collapse in international trade and has prompted governments to impose various restrictive measures to protect public health, further exacerbating the economic conditions.
